### Read the Bible: Exodus 33, John 12, Proverbs 9, Ephesians 2
Author: D. A. Carson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/devotionals/read-the-bible/exodus-33-john-12-proverbs-9-ephesians-2/
Passage: Proverbs 9:1-12
Points:
- Proverbs sharpens life's complexities into a fundamental choice between embracing wisdom or following folly.
- Wisdom prepares a stable dwelling and invites the receptive to feast on understanding and leave ignorance behind.
- How an individual responds to correction tests their heart, distinguishing a teachable, wise person from an arrogant mocker.
- Biblical wisdom is neither secular intellectual prowess nor esoteric knowledge, but wholehearted devotion to God.
- Beginning with the fear and knowledge of the Lord brings true insight and enduring blessings to one's life.
